tweets.text: The FBI briefly became one of the largest Bitcoin whales in the world in 2013 after seizing over 144,000 BTC from the Silk Road, holding roughly 1.5% of the entire circulating supply at the time.

tweets.author: lowestodd.bsky.social
tweets.text: In August 2010, a code bug created 184 billion Bitcoin out of thin air in block 74,638. Satoshi and early devs spotted the integer overflow, patched the code, and soft-forked the chain to erase the fake supply within five hours.

tweets.author: lowestodd.bsky.social
tweets.text: When WikiLeaks turned to Bitcoin in late 2010 after Visa and Mastercard blocked their donations, Satoshi pleaded on the forums: 'The heat will destroy us at this stage.' Just a few days later, Satoshi vanished from the Bitcointalk forum forever.
